# ARKhives 8.16.1 — efficient bank checks and sync diagnostics

## Bank traffic

- Bank checks back off from 30 seconds to five minutes when published content stays unchanged. After five minutes without interaction, bank checks use a 30-minute interval. Returning to the app brings the next check forward, and Learning & sync has a manual Check bank updates action.
- Failed bank requests back off up to 16 minutes. Manual requests have a short cooldown. The status heartbeat does not defeat bank backoff, and closing an observed study session releases a deferred native bank update.
- Personal review progress keeps its separate fast sync loop. Bank content can take up to the displayed next-check time to arrive automatically; request a manual check when needed.
- A simulated day of unchanged content required 291 active bank checks or 48 idle checks, compared with the previous mobile rate of 5,760 and desktop rate of 4,320. These are controlled policy calculations, not measured billing savings; downloads, administration, retries and manual checks add traffic.
- Mobile stages complete changed reviewer JSON before switching its catalog. A partial transfer keeps the previous visible catalog and its learning totals.

## Learning & sync

- Shows the engine, progress revision, successful connection time, bank status and last/next bank check.
- Adds local monthly counts for bank checks, downloads, publications, cached downloads, progress checks/downloads/uploads and failed requests. Counts contain no account IDs, tokens, questions or answers and remain on the device.
- These are local request diagnostics, not account-wide billable R2 operation counts. Administrators can open the Cloudflare dashboard to inspect actual account usage. Monitoring does not write analytics events into R2.
- Shows the approximate serialized progress size and warns above 24 MiB, before the approximately 32 MiB cloud-document limit. No study history is deleted automatically. A rejected upload stays local and retains its retry identity.
- Browser counts are buffered briefly and desktop counts are periodically saved. An abrupt termination can lose recent diagnostic counts; this does not affect durable study-review storage.

## Verification

- Added convergence testing for 12 offline writers, 144 FSRS events, opposite merge orders, retries and MCQ counters.
- Added a roughly 25 MB progress fixture that survives two cloud-capacity rejections and a local-store restart with the original pending operation ID.
- Added bank-policy, idle/resume, manual-refresh and persistent usage checks.
- Browser acceptance covers local usage, manual bank refresh, tablet portrait/landscape, background recovery and concurrent reviews after offline edits. Chromium verifies the installed offline shell. WebKit engine checks disable service workers so remote fixtures can be intercepted reliably; its offline-shell behavior still needs physical Safari acceptance.

## Device acceptance

Automated phone/tablet browser tests are not tests on the owner's physical iPhone or iPad. Follow PHYSICAL_DEVICE_SYNC_CHECKLIST.md for actual background suspension, storage pressure and device gestures. Full multi-user production load, account-wide billing integration and automatic history archival remain separate work.
